d:
What is love without heartbreak? Daryaa captures the pain of longing and emotional turbulence with Amit Trivedi’s haunting composition, brought alive by the soulful voices of Ammy Virk and Shahid Mallya in Manmarziyaan.
Credits
Song: Daryaa
Film: Manmarziyaan
Singers: Ammy Virk, Shahid Mallya
Music: Amit Trivedi
Lyrics: Shellee
Produced & Arranged By: Amit Trivedi
